variants.headline: Ordered goods reach the dock
variants.body: The company {company} has received its imported order of {good} at the port. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: An order completes its long journey
variants.body: Imported {good} ordered by {company} has landed at the colony's port. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Imports landed and paid for
variants.body: The company {company} has taken delivery of its home-world order of {good}. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
